summary: The glucose data shows variability with both hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia. Basal rates and targets are segmented, and SMB/UAM are enabled.

analysis_steps.findings: Good CGM coverage with 3995 valid entries and 10 gaps.
Glucose is generally within range but with variability.
analysis_steps.evidence: Average glucose is 121.6 mg/dL with a standard deviation of 39.7 mg/dL.

analysis_steps.findings: Basal rates and targets are segmented across the day.
analysis_steps.evidence: Basal rates vary from 0.5 to 0.8 U/h. Targets range from 90 to 100 mg/dL.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: Limited data on basal rate effectiveness during fasting periods.

analysis_steps.findings: CR, ISF, and DIA settings are in place.
analysis_steps.evidence: CR ranges from 10.5 to 13.2 g/U. ISF is 56 mg/dL/U. DIA is 10 hours.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: Limited insight into the effectiveness of these settings during meals and corrections.

analysis_steps.findings: SMB and UAM are enabled with aggressive settings.
analysis_steps.evidence: SMB is always enabled with UAM. SMB interval is 3 minutes.

analysis_steps.findings: Autosens is disabled, and Dynamic ISF is enabled.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: Limited insight into the effectiveness of Dynamic ISF adjustments.

analysis_steps.findings: No explicit meal strategy is declared.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: Limited insight into meal bolus timing and percentage.

analysis_steps.findings: No meal carbs or e-carbs are declared.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: No data on meal carb amounts or absorption patterns.

analysis_steps.findings: The primary issue is glucose variability.
analysis_steps.evidence: Variability is observed with both hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia.
analysis_steps.data_gaps: Limited insight into meal strategies and carb absorption.

recommendations.title: Review ISF setting
recommendations.description: ISF is 56 mg/dL/U. Review its effectiveness.

recommendations.title: Adjust max IOB
recommendations.description: Max IOB is 25 U. Consider lowering it.

parameter_decisions.parameter: AAPS / max basal and max IOB limits
parameter_decisions.rationale: To reduce risk of excessive IOB.

meal_strategy_summary.next_observation: Record meal carb amounts and timing.

education: Understand the impact of ISF and max IOB on glucose variability.
safety_notes: Make changes one at a time.
